run_list_command: run the ListCommand to list all configured benchpress jobs with name, description, and tags
list_jobs_by_scope: run the ListCommand with --by-scope flag to group benchmarks by scope like app, micro, or kernel
list_jobs_by_component: run the ListCommand with --by-component flag to group benchmarks by the components being tested
populate_parser_list: populate a click subparser with the list command arguments for --by-scope and --by-component flags
create_job_listing: create a tabulated job listing from a list of job dicts grouped by scope or component key
